name: Just in Case™
description: An assortment of everyday carry essentials focused on personal health, packaged in a durable tin case. You can modify the contents to your liking, making it a useful kit for urban dwellers.

features: Fresh packed upon receipt of order
materials: U3070-3972: bulk, tin case, custom gloss label
printing: Digital: full color on one side

thumbnail.alt: Hinged metal tin kit with a custom printed logo band and a contents list on an orange side label.
